headline: Stlican Shelf Re-ignites While Violent Churn Grips Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, ferocious volatility has broadened across the northern theater as Stlican Shelf re-ignites with ten strategic base transfers over the last two hours, leaving Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost heavily contested with two redoubts reduced to no-man's-land. Callahan's Passage continues its frantic churn unabated, yielding thirteen additional base exchanges in two hours and over twenty-two hundred casualties as fighting swirls through The Latch, Crumbling Post, and The Crumbling Passage. Strategic turnover in Weathered Expanse has moderated to three transfers over the same span, yet attritional violence persists with nearly two thousand fresh casualties logged across Frostmarch and Wightwalk. Off the western coast, Fisherman's Row registers modest activity with three shifts and light casualties, confirming its earlier decline in tempo. Meanwhile, the meat grinders along Nevish Line and Mooring County sustain steep casualty tolls—surpassing thirteen hundred and fifteen hundred losses in two hours respectively—yet neither sector has yielded strategic base alterations during the interval.
